fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on Miami city commission actions and contracting, including criticism of awarding a municipal band contract to the Scotch Highlanders Band and discussion of local musicians. Coverage also addresses a police scandal and grand jury investigations, with references to State's Attorney Vernon Hawthorne and assistant Dick Hunt, and speculation about broader inquiry into county courthouse affairs. Additional pieces discuss proposed sites for a new Miami post office (including the Central School site), the Dade County Fair, and Miami-area business topics such as the ice industry; the issue also contains local columns, political notes, and extensive advertising and entertainment listings.
